org.portico.lrc.model

Class ModelMerger

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.model.ModelMerger

  • public class ModelMerger
extends Object
    This class provides the logic for merging multiple ObjectModels together into a single, unified object model as required by IEEE-1516e. This behaviour will just arbitrarily merge together modules as the 1516e specification demands, even if the models are for earlier HLA versions.

      • merge

        public static ObjectModel merge(List<ObjectModel> models)
                         throws JInconsistentFDD,
                                JRTIinternalError
        From the given list, merge all subsequent object models into the first and return it. If any of the modules cannot be merged for any reason, throw a JInconsistentFDD exception.

        Not that this method will ALTER the first model (merging everything else into it) but not alter any of the subsequent models (copies of them will be made).

        Throws:
        JInconsistentFDD
        JRTIinternalError

      • merge

        public static ObjectModel merge(ObjectModel base,
                                List<ObjectModel> extensions)
                         throws JInconsistentFDD,
                                JRTIinternalError
        Merges the provided extensions into the base. This will irrevocably alter the base but will not change any of the extensions.
        Throws:
        JInconsistentFDD
        JRTIinternalError

      • mergeDryRun

        public static void mergeDryRun(ObjectModel base,
                               List<ObjectModel> extensions)
                        throws JInconsistentFDD,
                               JRTIinternalError
        This is the same as merge(List) except that it doesn't make changes to ANY of the provided models. Use this when you just want to validate that two models will infact merge.

        This will merge the given extension modules into the provided base model

        Throws:
        JInconsistentFDD
        JRTIinternalError
